title: Correct potential difference
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be 120 V (or equivalent).

title: Correct work calculation
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be 2.4 × 10⁻⁸ J (or equivalent).

title: Proper formula application
description: Important: Uses U = E·d·cosθ with correct angle (53°) for potential difference in uniform field.

title: Work-potential relationship
description: Important: Applies W = q·U to calculate work from potential difference and charge.

title: Trigonometric function selection
description: Important: Recognizes that cosine (not sine) relates displacement component parallel to field.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains correct units throughout (V/m, m, C, V, J) with proper conversions.

title: Sign interpretation
description: Optional: Correctly interprets sign of work relative to charge movement direction.

title: Using sine instead of cosine
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly uses sinθ instead of cosθ in potential difference formula.

title: Angle misunderstanding
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong angle (e.g., 37° instead of 53°) in trigonometric calculation.
